channel: execution-dev/_threads/EIP-8038 x EIP-2930 Access List Costs
searchText: Having it priced 100 gas cheaper than cold access makes sense. If you add the data cost, which not only applies to the floor but always, ALs are already economically irrational to use. This was a goal of 7981, even though it meant moving away from the "keep things as-is and count data cost only to floor" priciple (e.g. 8131). This is also the number we may want to then use in 7928 for the anti-dos heuristic. I thought we were pricing out Optional access lists by design? <@792404665068158998>
